items.bewering: In graad 5 het jy geleer dat 'n voedselketting in 'n ry wys wie vir wie eet.
items.bron: Oxford CAPS Tracker and Planner NST Grade 5 (https://oxford.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Oxford_CAPS_Tracker_and_Planner_NST_Grade_5.pdf), seen only as a search summary and not opened. It puts 'Food chains' in Graad 5, Kwartaal 1, weeks 6-7, and says it follows the DBE 2023/24 ATP. Two more search results agree: Graad 5 CAPS Kwartaal 1 summaries list food chains, and the WCED portal hosts the DBE Graad 5 NST ATP (it returned 403, so I could not read it). Weakest source in this report: a person can confirm it in a minute against the CAPS PDF, which I was told not to open.

items.bewering: In 'n ekostelsel is daar baie sulke kettings op dieselfde plek. Die kettings deel plante en diere en haak daarom in mekaar. Saam vorm hulle 'n voedselweb.
items.bron: MacArthur's framing of food webs as interconnected chains with many energy pathways, cited in Gotelli, Null Models ch. 10 (https://uvm.edu/~ngotelli/manuscriptpdfs/Null%20Models%20Chapter%2010.pdf). The 'web' and 'haak in mekaar' image holds: shared organisms are where chains join, which is exactly what a food web is. A learner reasoning further from it is not led astray.

items.bewering: 'n Voedselweb wys die kosverhoudings tussen die lewende dinge in een ekostelsel.
items.bron: Varsity Tutors, food web lesson (https://www.varsitytutors.com/practice/lessons/biology/food-web); Colorado CEEE food web teacher guide (https://ceee.colorado.edu/sites/default/files/2025-08/Energy%20Pyramids%20and%20Food%20Webs%20Teacher%20Guide.pdf).

items.bewering: Baie diere eet meer as een soort kos. Baie diere word ook deur meer as een soort dier geëet.
items.bron: The diet sources below show this for every animal in the lesson. Springbok: SANBI Red List (https://speciesstatus.sanbi.org/taxa/detail/01940/). Cheetah: Mills 1984, Koedoe (https://doaj.org/article/591592e7de734bb1bca6f4addc2f0360). Secretarybird: Biodiversity Observations (https://journals.uct.ac.za/index.php/BO/article/view/251).

items.bewering: 'n Springbok vreet gras en die blare van bossies.
items.bron: SANBI Red List of South African Species, springbok: a mixed feeder that eats both browse and grass, prefers young grass and otherwise browses low karroid shrubs (https://speciesstatus.sanbi.org/taxa/detail/01940/). Britannica, springbok (https://www.britannica.com/animal/springbok-mammal).

items.bewering: 'n Jagluiperd vang springbokke.
items.bron: Mills 1984, prey selection of large carnivores in the Southern Kalahari, Koedoe: cheetahs prey heavily on springbok (https://doaj.org/article/591592e7de734bb1bca6f4addc2f0360). Mills and Mills, Kalahari Cheetahs (OUP): springbok are the second most important prey after steenbok (https://academic.oup.com/book/26973/chapter/196162370). The lesson says only that cheetahs catch springbok, which is true either way.

items.bewering: 'n Sprinkaan vreet gras
items.bron: NSW Department of Education, Field of Mars EEC grasshopper fact sheet: mostly herbivores that eat grasses, leaves, stems, flowers and seeds (https://fieldofmar-e.schools.nsw.gov.au/fact-sheets/invertebrates/grasshopper-fact-sheet). University of Würzburg Biozentrum: grass-preferring grasshoppers dominate grassy meadows (https://www.biozentrum.uni-wuerzburg.de/en/news/archive/news-single/news/what-grasshoppers-feed-on/).

items.bewering: 'n sekretarisvoël vang sprinkane.
items.bron: Biodiversity Observations (UCT), snakes in the diet of Secretarybirds: insects form most of the diet, and one gizzard held 13 grasshoppers (https://journals.uct.ac.za/index.php/BO/article/view/251). San Diego Zoo secretarybird fact sheet lists grasshoppers (https://ielc.libguides.com/sdzg/factsheets/secretarybird/diet).

items.bewering: 'n Bobbejaan eet gras en sade, maar hy vang ook sprinkane.
items.bron: A 1978 study of a chacma baboon troop at Cape Point found that 95% of the diet was plant matter (grass, seeds, fruit, leaves) and recorded grasshoppers among the invertebrates eaten. I read only the abstract, as surfaced in search; it is linked from the chacma baboon results (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chacma_baboon). SANBI Red List, chacma baboon (https://speciesstatus.sanbi.org/taxa/detail/2174).

items.bewering: Die sprinkaan is dus deel van twee kettings: een eindig by die voël en die ander by die bobbejaan. By die sprinkaan kruis die kettings, en so word hulle 'n web.
items.bron: This follows from the lesson's own stated links (gras -> sprinkaan -> sekretarisvoël; gras -> sprinkaan -> bobbejaan), each confirmed above. On the mapping: strictly, the two chains share the stretch gras -> sprinkaan and split at the grasshopper, rather than crossing at one point. They also meet at the grass. 'Kruis' still conveys the idea that chains meet at a shared organism, and that idea is correct. Nothing in it leads a learner to a false conclusion. Noted, not a defect.

items.bewering: Die meeste van hierdie diere eet ook dinge wat nie hier genoem word nie.
items.bron: This holds for every one of the five animals, so 'die meeste' is safely true. Springbok also eat forbs, succulents and tsama melons (Britannica, https://www.britannica.com/animal/springbok-mammal). Cheetahs also take steenbok (Kalahari Cheetahs, https://academic.oup.com/book/26973/chapter/196162370). Secretarybirds also take snakes, rodents and lizards (https://ielc.libguides.com/sdzg/factsheets/secretarybird/diet). Baboons also eat fruit, bulbs and other animals (SANBI, https://speciesstatus.sanbi.org/taxa/detail/2174). Grasshoppers also eat leaves, flowers and seeds (https://fieldofmar-e.schools.nsw.gov.au/fact-sheets/invertebrates/grasshopper-fact-sheet).

items.bewering: In 'n getekende web wys elke pyl van die kos na die eter. Die pyl loop van die gras na die springbok en nie andersom nie. Dit wys waarheen die kos gaan.
items.bron: Colorado CEEE Energy Pyramids and Food Webs teacher guide: each arrow points from the organism eaten to the consumer, in the direction energy flows (https://ceee.colorado.edu/sites/default/files/2025-08/Energy%20Pyramids%20and%20Food%20Webs%20Teacher%20Guide.pdf). Varsity Tutors food web lesson (https://www.varsitytutors.com/practice/lessons/biology/food-web).

items.bewering: Elke ketting in hierdie web begin by 'n plant soos gras of bossies.
items.bron: Checked against the web the lesson itself builds: grass, shrub leaves and seeds are the only starting foods named, and all are plants. The claim is limited to 'hierdie web', so it does not say that every food chain anywhere starts with a plant.

items.bewering: 'n Plant maak sy eie kos, en daarom noem ons hom 'n produsent. Hy maak die kos vir sy eie gebruik. 'n Dier kry daardie kos deur die plant te eet of deur 'n ander dier te eet wat dit reeds gekry het.
items.bron: Missouri Botanical Garden food chains handout: producers make their own food by photosynthesis, and consumers must eat plants or other animals (https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/Portals/0/Education/Students%20and%20Teachers/PDFs/foodchains-pre.pdf).

items.bewering: In die see is baie van die produsente alge.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, Plankton Revealed: phytoplankton, including diatoms, dinoflagellates and green algae, form the base of aquatic food webs (https://education.test.nationalgeographic.org/resource/plankton-revealed). Gettysburg College open text: phytoplankton make about 95% of marine primary production (https://geo.libretexts.org/Courses/Gettysburg_College/Oceans_of_Data_(Gownaris)/07%3A_Primary_Production/7.01%3A_Primary_Production). 'Baie' is the right quantifier, because cyanobacteria and seagrasses are producers that are not algae.

items.bewering: Die diere in die web is die verbruikers. Hulle kan nie self kos maak nie en kry dit deur plante of ander diere te eet.
items.bron: Missouri Botanical Garden food chains handout: consumers cannot make their own food and must eat plants or other animals (https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/Portals/0/Education/Students%20and%20Teachers/PDFs/foodchains-pre.pdf).

items.bewering: Die springbok en die sprinkaan vreet hoofsaaklik plante. Albei is dus herbivore.
items.bron: SANBI, springbok (https://speciesstatus.sanbi.org/taxa/detail/01940/). NSW grasshopper fact sheet: 'Grasshoppers are mostly herbivores' (https://fieldofmar-e.schools.nsw.gov.au/fact-sheets/invertebrates/grasshopper-fact-sheet). 'Hoofsaaklik' correctly covers the small amounts of other matter some grasshoppers eat.

items.bewering: Die jagluiperd en die sekretarisvoël eet hoofsaaklik vleis en is karnivore.
items.bron: Cheetah: Mills 1984 (https://doaj.org/article/591592e7de734bb1bca6f4addc2f0360). Secretarybird: an animal-eating bird of prey whose diet is insects, snakes, rodents and lizards (https://journals.uct.ac.za/index.php/BO/article/view/251; https://ielc.libguides.com/sdzg/factsheets/secretarybird/diet). 'Vleis' is used here in the broad sense of animal food, which is how the lesson's own begrip for karnivoor uses it. Most of the secretarybird's diet by count is insects, which are still animal food.

items.bewering: Die bobbejaan eet plante sowel as diere en is 'n omnivoor.
items.bron: SANBI Red List, chacma baboon: mostly fruit, leaves and underground plant parts, with a smaller share of animal matter (https://speciesstatus.sanbi.org/taxa/detail/2174). Chacma baboon, Wikipedia: omnivorous (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chacma_baboon).

items.bewering: Dooie blare onder 'n boom word bruin en sag en is na 'n ruk weg. 'n Omgevalle stomp word mettertyd so sag dat hy in jou hand verkrummel. Dit is veral die werk van die ontbinders.
items.bron: Alabama Wildlife Federation log decomposition sign (https://www.alabamawildlife.org/uploadedFiles/File/Example_Log_Decomposition_Sign_QR_Sep_2020.pdf). NSW National Parks, Cycles of life in the rainforest (https://www.nationalparks.nsw.gov.au/-/media/visitor/files/pdf/education/rainforests-of-nsw/cycles-of-life-in-the-rainforest.pdf). Fungi and bacteria break down leaf litter and wood. 'Veral' is the right quantifier, because earthworms, millipedes and termites also break material up.

items.bewering: Hulle breek dooie plante en diere af. Baie ontbinders is mikro-organismes wat jy net deur 'n mikroskoop kan sien.
items.bron: Unacademy, decomposers: most decomposers are microscopic organisms such as bacteria (https://unacademy.com/content/decomposers/). NSW National Parks, Cycles of life in the rainforest (https://www.nationalparks.nsw.gov.au/-/media/visitor/files/pdf/education/rainforests-of-nsw/cycles-of-life-in-the-rainforest.pdf).

items.bewering: Party swamme soos sampioene is ook ontbinders, en hulle kan jy wel sien.
items.bron: Unacademy, decomposers: fungi such as mushrooms and moulds are the visible decomposers (https://unacademy.com/content/decomposers/). 'Party' is correct, because some mushroom-forming fungi are not decomposers (mycorrhizal or parasitic ones).

items.bewering: Wanneer ontbinders 'n dooie blaar afbreek, gaan voedingstowwe uit die blaar in die grond in. 'n Plant neem hulle deur sy wortels op en gebruik hulle om te groei.
items.bron: Decomposition releases simple inorganic nutrients such as nitrates and phosphates, which plants then absorb (NSW National Parks, https://www.nationalparks.nsw.gov.au/-/media/visitor/files/pdf/education/rainforests-of-nsw/cycles-of-life-in-the-rainforest.pdf). LSU AgCenter, 'What do plants eat?': roots take up minerals that matter for health (https://www.lsuagcenter.com/portals/communications/news/news_archive/2009/august/get_it_growing/what-do-plants-eat).

items.bewering: Hierdie voedingstowwe is nie die plant se kos nie. Die plant maak sy kos steeds self, maar sonder hierdie stowwe groei hy swak.
items.bron: USDA Forest Service Tropical Nursery Manual, plant nutrition: calling fertiliser 'plant food' is a misconception, because plants make their own carbohydrates (https://npn.rngr.net/publications/tropical-nursery-manual/plant-nutrition-and-fertilization/at_download/file). NSTA lesson 'Is it food for plants?': soil supplies minerals and water, not food (https://www.nsta.org/lesson-plan/it-food-plants).

items.bewering: 'n Springbok wat die gras vreet, kry die voedingstowwe ook in sy lyf. Na die springbok se dood breek ontbinders af wat van hom oorbly. So gaan dieselfde stowwe terug na die grond en weer deur die web.
items.bron: This is nutrient cycling through the food web: matter passes from plant to consumer, and decomposers return it to the soil for plants to take up again (NSW National Parks, https://www.nationalparks.nsw.gov.au/-/media/visitor/files/pdf/education/rainforests-of-nsw/cycles-of-life-in-the-rainforest.pdf). 'Wat van hom oorbly' correctly allows for part of the carcass going to a predator or scavenger first.

items.bewering: Stel jou voor die sprinkane in die grasveld word baie min. Die bobbejaan kan dikwels meer gras en sade eet. Die sekretarisvoël kan ander diere soos slange vang.
items.bron: Baboon: 95% plant diet and highly flexible (Cape Point 1978 study, via search; SANBI, https://speciesstatus.sanbi.org/taxa/detail/2174). Secretarybird takes snakes (Biodiversity Observations, https://journals.uct.ac.za/index.php/BO/article/view/251). MacArthur: a predator that eats many kinds of prey shifts to other prey when one declines (Gotelli, Null Models ch. 10, https://uvm.edu/~ngotelli/manuscriptpdfs/Null%20Models%20Chapter%2010.pdf).

items.bewering: 'n Dier wat net een soort kos eet, kry dit swaarder as sy enigste kos wegval.
items.bron: MacArthur's reasoning, cited in Gotelli, Null Models ch. 10: predators that eat only one prey are more strongly affected by changes in that prey (https://uvm.edu/~ngotelli/manuscriptpdfs/Null%20Models%20Chapter%2010.pdf). 'Enigste' sits inside a hypothetical about a specialist feeder. It makes no superlative claim about a real species.

items.bewering: Daarom hou genoeg biodiversiteit 'n ekostelsel gesond: dit hou meer paaie vir kos oop.
items.bron: MacArthur's 'many energy pathways' argument (Gotelli, Null Models ch. 10, https://uvm.edu/~ngotelli/manuscriptpdfs/Null%20Models%20Chapter%2010.pdf). Worm and Duffy 2003, biodiversity, productivity and stability in real food webs (https://indus.vims.edu/research/units/legacy/marine_biodiversity/publications/_pdf/Worm%20and%20Duffy%202003.pdf). The diversity-stability link is debated in detail in the research literature. The careful wording ('genoeg', 'hou ... gesond', 'meer paaie') claims only the well-supported part. On the mapping: 'paaie vir kos' maps onto the alternative feeding links in the web, which is the right idea.

items.bewering: voedselweb: Die voedselkettings van een ekostelsel wat by mekaar aansluit en deur mekaar loop.
items.bron: Varsity Tutors, food web lesson: a food web is the interconnected food chains of an ecosystem (https://www.varsitytutors.com/practice/lessons/biology/food-web).

items.bewering: voedselketting: 'n Ry lewende dinge wat begin by een wat sy eie kos maak. Elkeen daarna vreet die een voor hom.
items.bron: Missouri Botanical Garden food chains handout: a food chain starts with a producer, and each consumer eats the organism before it (https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/Portals/0/Education/Students%20and%20Teachers/PDFs/foodchains-pre.pdf). This describes grazing food chains, which is the kind a Graad 6 learner meets. Detritus chains are not in scope.

items.bewering: produsent: 'n Lewende ding wat sy eie kos maak, soos 'n plant.
items.bron: Missouri Botanical Garden food chains handout (https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/Portals/0/Education/Students%20and%20Teachers/PDFs/foodchains-pre.pdf). 'Soos' keeps it open to algae and other producers, which matches the 'Produsente' block.

items.bewering: verbruiker: 'n Lewende ding wat sy kos kry deur plante of diere te eet.
items.bron: Missouri Botanical Garden food chains handout (https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/Portals/0/Education/Students%20and%20Teachers/PDFs/foodchains-pre.pdf).

items.bewering: ontbinder: 'n Lewende ding wat dooie plante en diere afbreek en voedingstowwe na die grond teruggee.
items.bron: Unacademy, decomposers (https://unacademy.com/content/decomposers/). NSW National Parks, Cycles of life in the rainforest (https://www.nationalparks.nsw.gov.au/-/media/visitor/files/pdf/education/rainforests-of-nsw/cycles-of-life-in-the-rainforest.pdf). On land the nutrients go to the soil. Decomposers in water return them to the water, but the lesson's decomposer content is all on land, so read alone the entry is still true.

items.bewering: mikro-organisme: 'n Lewende ding wat so klein is dat 'n mens dit net deur 'n mikroskoop kan sien.
items.bron: Unacademy, decomposers: microscopic organisms such as bacteria and protozoa (https://unacademy.com/content/decomposers/). This is the standard definition of a microorganism.

items.bewering: voedingstof: 'n Stof wat 'n lewende ding nodig het om te groei en gesond te bly. Party voedingstowwe in kos gee ook energie.
items.bron: LSU AgCenter, 'What do plants eat?' (https://www.lsuagcenter.com/portals/communications/news/news_archive/2009/august/get_it_growing/what-do-plants-eat). 'Party ... gee ook energie' is correct: carbohydrates and fats give energy, and minerals do not. The entry agrees with the 'Terug na die grond' block, which says soil nutrients are not the plant's food.

items.bewering: herbivoor: 'n Dier wat hoofsaaklik plante eet, soos gras, blare of vrugte.
items.bron: Missouri Botanical Garden food chains handout, consumer types (https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/Portals/0/Education/Students%20and%20Teachers/PDFs/foodchains-pre.pdf).

items.bewering: karnivoor: 'n Dier wat hoofsaaklik vleis eet.
items.bron: Missouri Botanical Garden food chains handout, consumer types (https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/Portals/0/Education/Students%20and%20Teachers/PDFs/foodchains-pre.pdf).

items.bewering: omnivoor: 'n Dier wat plante sowel as vleis eet.
items.bron: Missouri Botanical Garden food chains handout, consumer types (https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/Portals/0/Education/Students%20and%20Teachers/PDFs/foodchains-pre.pdf).

items.bewering: ekostelsel: 'n Gebied waar lewende dinge van mekaar en van die nie-lewende dinge om hulle afhang.
items.bron: Save My Exams AQA biology notes on communities and ecosystems: an ecosystem is a community of living organisms together with the non-living parts of their environment, interacting (https://savemyexams.com/a-level/biology/aqa/17/revision-notes/7-genetics-populations-evolution--ecosystems-a-level-only/7-4-populations-in-ecosystems-a-level-only/7-4-1-communities). EFSA glossary, ecosystem (https://www.efsa.europa.eu/en/glossary/ecosystem).

items.bewering: biodiversiteit: Hoeveel verskillende soorte lewende dinge daar in 'n plek of op die hele Aarde is.
items.bron: Save My Exams GCSE biodiversity notes: biodiversity as the variety of species in an area or on Earth (https://savemyexams.com/gcse/biology/edexcel/18/revision-notes/9-ecosystems--material-cycles/9-1-the-organism-in-the-environment/9-1-5-biodiversity). The entry covers species richness, which is the main part of the full definition. It leaves out genetic and ecosystem diversity. That is a simplification, not an untruth.

opsomming: All 40 claims check out, including every animal's diet in the grassland web (springbok, cheetah, grasshopper, secretarybird, baboon), the arrow direction, the producer, consumer and decomposer content, and all twelve definitions. The weakest source is the line saying learners met food chains in Graad 5: I confirmed it only through a CAPS tracker and summaries, not the CAPS document itself, so a person may want to glance at the Graad 5 CAPS PDF.
